text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While walking around the academy, I<n>spot Mejiro
Dober deeply absorbed<n>in a book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense... So adjusting<n>one's diet is the
best way to burn fat<n>efficiently...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Don't just jump out at<n>me like that!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? N-no, this is, uh... Yes, I am...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell anyone I was reading this,<n>okay?
Especially not Ryan and the<n>others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell anyone I was reading this,<n>okay?
Especially not Ryan and the<n>others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
They'd probably all scramble to help<n>me if they
found out, but I don't want<n>to bother them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The thing is... I'm not sure I'll be able<n>to do this
right alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, come on! Do I have to say it<n>outright?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: So, um... If you have the time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Can you help me with this as part of<n>my training? I
think it'll be more<n>effective that way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try following what this book<n>says, so...
could you help me out?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We start working on Mejiro Dober's<n>diet, and it
seems to really help!
